API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIURL Filtering PolicyAdd Rule
Add Rule
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/urlFilteringRules

Adds a URL Filtering Policy rule.

If you are using the Admin Rank feature, refer to About Admin Rank to determine which value to provide for rank when adding a policy rule. If you are not using Admin Rank, the rank value must be 7.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

The URL filtering rule information.

id
int32

URL Filtering Rule ID

name
string
REQUIRED

Rule Name

order
int32

Order of execution of rule with respect to other URL Filtering rules

protocols
string[]

Protocol criteria

Possible values: [SMRULEF_ZPA_BROKERS_RULE, ANY_RULE, TCP_RULE, UDP_RULE, DOHTTPS_RULE, TUNNELSSL_RULE, HTTP_PROXY, FOHTTP_RULE, FTP_RULE, HTTPS_RULE, HTTP_RULE, SSL_RULE, TUNNEL_RULE]

locations
object[]
groups
object[]
departments
object[]
users
object[]

state
string

Rule State

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

timeWindows
object[]
workloadGroups
object[]
rank
int32

Admin rank of the admin who creates this rule

requestMethods
string[]

Request method for which the rule must be applied. If not set, rule is applied to all methods

Possible values: [OPTIONS, GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, TRACE, CONNECT, OTHER]

endUserNotificationUrl
string

URL of end user notification page to be displayed when the rule is matched. Not applicable if either 'overrideUsers' or 'overrideGroups' is specified.

overrideUsers
object[]
overrideGroups
object[]
blockOverride
boolean

When set to true, a 'BLOCK' action triggered by the rule could be overridden. If true and both overrideGroup and overrideUsers are not set, the BLOCK triggered by this rule could be overridden for any users. If blockOverride is not set, 'BLOCK' action cannot be overridden.

Default value: false
timeQuota
int32

Time quota in minutes, after which the URL Filtering rule is applied. If not set, no quota is enforced. If a policy rule action is set to 'BLOCK', this field is not applicable.

sizeQuota
int32

Size quota in KB beyond which the URL Filtering rule is applied. If not set, no quota is enforced. If a policy rule action is set to 'BLOCK', this field is not applicable.

description
string

Additional information about the URL Filtering rule

locationGroups
object[]
labels
object[]
validityStartTime
int32

If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the URL Filtering rule is valid starting on this date and time.

validityEndTime
int32

If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the URL Filtering rule ceases to be valid on this end date and time.

validityTimeZoneId
string

If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the URL Filtering rule date and time is valid based on this time zone ID.

lastModifiedTime
int32

When the rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
enforceTimeValidity
boolean

Enforce a set a validity time period for the URL Filtering rule. .

devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
deviceTrustLevels
string[]

List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

Possible values: [ANY, UNKNOWN_DEVICETRUSTLEVEL, LOW_TRUST, MEDIUM_TRUST, HIGH_TRUST]

action
string

Action taken when traffic matches rule criteria.

Note: The ISOLATE action is available only if Cloud Browser Isolation is enabled for your organization. .

Possible values: [BLOCK, CAUTION, ALLOW, ISOLATE, ICAP_RESPONSE]

cbiProfile
object
ciparule
boolean

If set to true, the CIPA Compliance rule is enabled

Default value: false

200

Successful Operation

state
string

Rule State

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

timeWindows
object[]
workloadGroups
object[]
rank
int32

Admin rank of the admin who creates this rule

requestMethods
string[]

Request method for which the rule must be applied. If not set, rule is applied to all methods

Possible values: [OPTIONS, GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, TRACE, CONNECT, OTHER]

endUserNotificationUrl
string

URL of end user notification page to be displayed when the rule is matched. Not applicable if either 'overrideUsers' or 'overrideGroups' is specified.

overrideUsers
object[]
overrideGroups
object[]
blockOverride
boolean

When set to true, a 'BLOCK' action triggered by the rule could be overridden. If true and both overrideGroup and overrideUsers are not set, the BLOCK triggered by this rule could be overridden for any users. If blockOverride is not set, 'BLOCK' action cannot be overridden.

Default value: false
timeQuota
int32

Time quota in minutes, after which the URL Filtering rule is applied. If not set, no quota is enforced. If a policy rule action is set to 'BLOCK', this field is not applicable.

sizeQuota
int32

Size quota in KB beyond which the URL Filtering rule is applied. If not set, no quota is enforced. If a policy rule action is set to 'BLOCK', this field is not applicable.

description
string

Additional information about the URL Filtering rule

locationGroups
object[]
labels
object[]
validityStartTime
int32

If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the URL Filtering rule is valid starting on this date and time.

validityEndTime
int32

If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the URL Filtering rule ceases to be valid on this end date and time.

validityTimeZoneId
string

If enforceTimeValidity is set to true, the URL Filtering rule date and time is valid based on this time zone ID.

lastModifiedTime
int32

When the rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
enforceTimeValidity
boolean

Enforce a set a validity time period for the URL Filtering rule. .

devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
deviceTrustLevels
string[]

List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

Possible values: [ANY, UNKNOWN_DEVICETRUSTLEVEL, LOW_TRUST, MEDIUM_TRUST, HIGH_TRUST]

action
string

Action taken when traffic matches rule criteria.

Note: The ISOLATE action is available only if Cloud Browser Isolation is enabled for your organization. .

Possible values: [BLOCK, CAUTION, ALLOW, ISOLATE, ICAP_RESPONSE]

cbiProfile
object
ciparule
boolean

If set to true, the CIPA Compliance rule is enabled

Default value: false
